title: Ahom-Buranji: From the Earliest Time to the End of Ahom Rule (1930)
title_english: Ahom-Buranji: From the Earliest Time to the End of Ahom Rule (1930)
title_as: আহোম বুৰঞ্জী: মূল টাই পাঠ আৰু ইংৰাজী অনুবাদ (১৯৩০)
author: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua (Translator & Editor)
genre: Primary Tai Bilingual Chronicle / Facsimile Edition
provenance: Calcutta: Baptist Mission Press / Shillong: Assam Government / Internet Archive (ahom-buranji)
description: The magnum opus of Tai-Ahom historiography and philology. Transcribed from an ancient sanchi-bark manuscript preserved in Khalaighogra Mauza, Sibsagar and translated under Sir Edward Gait. Features the authentic Ahom language text with parallel English translation, recording the celestial origins of the Tai dynasty from Lengdon to Khunlung and Khunlai, Sukapha's conquest and pacification of the valley, and centuries of dynastic rule.
